hook: Manchester City had not won a league in forty-four years. Then this happened.
narration: Final day of the Premier League season. Manchester City need to beat QPR to win the title. Eighty-eighth minute, they're losing two-one. Forty-four years without a league. Then Dzeko equalises in stoppage time. But that's not enough. They need three points. Last kick of the season. Forty-four years of pain. Ended by one touch. LIKE if you watched it live. COMMENT your favourite stoppage-time goal.
title_options: The 30 seconds that ended 44 years of waiting
AGUEROOOOO — the last kick that won City the league
How Manchester City won the title in 30 seconds
